title: Yellow Pages UAE Scraper

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Business categories to scrape from yello.ae, as slugs or plain names (e.g. 'restaurants', 'estate-agents', 'doctors and clinics'). Each is resolved to a yello.ae category listing and paginated. Leave empty if you provide Start URLs instead. NOT a free-text keyword search - use a real directory category.

city.title: Emirate / City filter
city.description: Optional emirate or city to restrict category results to (applied as a yello.ae city filter). Pick one value; leave empty to scrape all of the UAE. Only applies to the Categories input above, not to direct company Start URLs. Example: 'dubai'.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Direct yello.ae URLs to scrape, one per line: category pages (https://www.yello.ae/category/<slug>), location pages (https://www.yello.ae/location/<emirate>), or company pages (https://www.yello.ae/company/<id>/<slug>). Category and location URLs are paginated; company URLs are scraped directly. Use this for precise control. NOT for non-yello.ae domains.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of business records to return across the whole run (hard cap on billing). The run stops and finishes gracefully once this many businesses are scraped. Defaults to 1000; set lower for a quick test. Counts final business records, not intermediate listing pages.

enrichDetails.title: Enrich from detail pages
enrichDetails.description: VibeLeads scope: keep optional contact/detail extraction explicitly disabled during company discovery. A relevant stage for named qualified businesses requires verified actual build controls, source/use rights and suppression under the contact-use gate. Decline inseparable audience collection.
enrichDetails.x-vibeleads-discovery: explicitly disabled; verify actual build, otherwise decline route

proxyConfiguration.title: Restricted access control
proxyConfiguration.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
